Two heavyweight dessert genetics combine into a deeply flavored cultivar with the kind of dense, frost-blanketed bud structure that signals premium indoor cultivation at first glance. Effects Ice Cream Cake delivers a soothing body high paired with euphoric mental uplift. The cerebral side stays warm and pleasant; the body settles fully into comfortable relaxation — making this a strong cultivar for evening use, post-dinner decompression, or any moment where calming flavor character is the priority. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Ice Cream Cake THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest.
